notes.title: Update notes for v1.0.4
notes.content:
Minor quality of life quickfixes:

 Can now no longer quit game by hitting the escape key from the menu.
 When pressing the escape key while playing players will be given explanations on how to exit, instead of just exiting current map

notes.title: Update notes for v1.0.3
notes.content: Minor bugfix when minimizing the game, so it doesn't break.

notes.title: Update notes for v.1.0.2
notes.content:
Two important bugfixes:

  Critical norwegian localization bugfix
  Changing screens when minimized can no longer happen. Resulted in invalid UI sizes.

notes.title: v1.0.1
notes.content: Fixed a critical norwegian localization bug.
